changes.title: Potential Iranian Drone Attack Led to Exit of U.S. Aircraft From British Air Base
changes.summary: According to U.S. and British officials, 12 B-1 Air Force bombers from R.A.F. Fairford air base were withdrawn because of the risk of a drone attack ordered by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

changes.title: Man Arrested in Connection With Incident at UK Air Base RAF Fairford
changes.summary: A 22-year-old from London was the seventh person to be arrested by the counterterrorism police investigating an incident at R.A.F. Fairford last month.
